request.system: You are the copy composer for the outdoor-gear brand Northbay Supply. You write on-brand campaign copy that is grounded strictly in the catalog facts you are given. Never invent product facts.
request.user:
Campaign type: newsletter
Goal: Newsletter: send to everyone on the list, it is general interest content.
Target segment: all_subscribers
Discount percent: 0.0
Voice: ['Write plainly and specifically; name the feature and what it does.', "Lead with the customer's trip, not the product's ego.", 'Prefer concrete numbers (weight, capacity, ratings) over adjectives.', "Respect the reader's experience; assume they know the outdoors.", 'Be honest about limits — say what the gear is not built for.', 'One clear call to action per message.']
Tone: ['grounded', 'practical', 'warm', 'understated', 'trail-tested', 'unpretentious']
Avoid these terms: ['guaranteed', 'miracle', 'risk-free', 'best ever', 'cure', '100% safe', 'unbreakable', 'lifetime warranty', 'revolutionary', "world's best", 'bulletproof']
Catalog facts (ground every claim in these):
(no products)
Product ids in scope: []
Return JSON with keys: subject, preview_text, body, cta_text, cta_url, claims (list), target_segment, discount_pct, product_ids (list). cta_url must be an https URL.

response:
```json
{
  "subject": "No gear drop this week — just a few thoughts from the trail",
  "preview_text": "Sometimes the best newsletter is an honest one.",
  "body": "Hey,

We don't have a product to put in front of you this week, and we're not going to fill that space with noise.

Instead, a quick note on something we think about a lot: the gear you already own is probably good enough for the next trip. The jacket in your closet still sheds rain. The boots that took three trips to break in know your feet by now. The pack you've cursed on steep climbs has also carried everything you needed.

We're in the business of selling gear, so we'll say it plainly when new gear genuinely solves a problem — wrong fit, worn-out materials, a gap in your kit for a specific type of trip. When that moment comes, we want to be the place you trust to give you straight information: real weights, honest ratings, and a clear-eyed take on what a piece of gear is and isn't built for.

That's the newsletter we're trying to write every time.

If there's a specific kind of trip you're planning — or a piece of kit you've been trying to figure out — hit reply. We read every one.

See you out there,
The Northbay Supply Team",
  "cta_text": "Browse the current catalog",
  "cta_url": "https://www.northbaysupply.com/catalog",
  "claims": [],
  "target_segment": "all_subscribers",
  "discount_pct": 0.0,
  "product_ids": []
}
```
